evidence.quoted_text:
adapter, _selection = live.production_adapter(
                    effects, overlay, unit=args.unit, runtime=args.runtime)
evidence.reason: The switch path still composes the adapter via live.production_adapter at lines 2498-2499 before switch_unit at line 2503. The adapter is therefore rendered from a HEAD observed outside the controller-lock fence that records prior_head, and the call passes no source/HEAD binding or comparison. A concurrent controller can move HEAD in that window, leaving the installed source and the journaled prior_head identifying different commits, so the finding remains an implementation correctness defect.
